## Anti-orphan posture (installed before slot launch)

- In-guest completion watcher `p4c-completion-watch.sh` — auto-shutdown
  ~20 min after the driver exits (the X1 pattern; park at disk-only
  billing inside D = 36 h).
- GCP dead-man STOP at create + 36 h (outer bound); in-guest timer
  2175 min; driver `harvest_reserve_s = 21600` withholds launches inside
  the reserve; the ≤ 1 h harvest-and-teardown-only restart sits inside
  the ceiling (REQ-XB-224).
- Progress polls pull to `~/hh-retained/p4x/p4c/progress/`.

## Resume instructions (if the operating session ends mid-window)

- The driver is session-independent (`setsid nohup`, run-root
  `/var/lib/hh/runs/run-root-p4c`). If the VM reaches TERMINATED via the
  watcher: `gcloud compute instances start hh-p4-p4c
  --project hh-p4-a1b2c3 --zone us-central1-a` (the ≤ 1 h restart
  allowance), then harvest + teardown per the recipe — verify the
  run-root is non-empty before delete (the fail-closed leg now owns
  this). Never `instances stop` mid-window — in-flight slots and the
  minting driver die with it.
- Driver stdout: `/var/lib/hh/runs/run-root-p4c/driver.log` (via
  journald sudo trail verbatim); slot dirs under `run-root-p4c/slots/`;
  session WAL under `/var/lib/hh/p4c/store-p4c/`.
